\subsection{1. Executive summary}




This module maps technical volunteering routes that can produce credible experience for Alexander without requiring a formal job offer.




The strongest opportunities are not generic volunteering roles. They are technical contribution paths where Alexander can produce visible artifacts:




\begin{itemize}
\item public repositories;
\item data visualizations;
\item GIS or map outputs;
\item XR accessibility resources;
\item small Unity/WebGL demos;
\item documentation;
\item workflow automation;
\item humanitarian mapping contributions;
\item civic-tech prototypes.
\end{itemize}




The highest ROI paths for Alexander are:




\begin{enumerate}
\item Humanitarian mapping / geospatial visualization.
\item XR accessibility / inclusive immersive design.
\item Games and immersive media for social impact.
\item AI/data support for nonprofits.
\item Open engineering / CAD / digital-twin adjacent communities.
\item Civic-tech prototyping.
\end{enumerate}




These can support future applications to roles in Unity WebGL, technical visualization, XR, simulation, digital twins and tools/pipeline.
